newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST - Panmure Gordon take honours in forex poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Panmure Gordon take honours in forex poll.

text.p: Panmure Gordon in London took the honours on Monday with its forecast for sterling against the dollar supplied to a Reuters survey a year ago.
The forecasts were reviewed on Monday on publication of the latest update of the Reuters survey of long-term independent forecasts for the British economy.
In April 1996, Panmure Gordon made a prediction for end-March this year of 1.63 dollars to the pound, the highest of 28 forecasts from banks, research houses and academic institutes.
In fact, cable traded at the end of the final day of the quarter at 1.6280. The mean of the 28 forecasts in the survey was 1.48 dollars.

The strength of sterling against the mark caught the experts in the Reuters survey by surprise, with the closest forecast among 26 supplied being 2.40 marks. That was more than 33 pfennigs away from 2.7305 marks, the rate for sterling on the last trading day of the first quarter.

More analysts were successful in their predictions for British interest rates, which are currently at 6.0 percent after a 25-basis-point rise last October. Thirteen out of 32 forecasters got it right.
